name: Gods Vengeance
overview: Scripture reveals that God alone holds the rightful authority to enact vengeance, as He declares, 'Vengeance is mine; I will repay' (Romans 12:19) and 'To me belongeth vengeance and recompence' (Deuteronomy 32:35). Believers are commanded not to avenge themselves or bear grudges, but to love their neighbors as themselves (Leviticus 19:18), trusting in God's righteous judgment. The Lord’s vengeance is executed with power and purpose, demonstrating His holiness and justice (Ezekiel 25:17; Psalms 94:1), contrasting with human notions of retribution such as 'an eye for an eye' (Matthew 5:38). This teaches that God’s vengeance underscores His sovereign justice and calls His people to respond in love and faithfulness rather than personal retaliation.
